answer: Step 1: register a bead holding no value and no vote. Step 2: require three ordered stages, each emitting a signed artifact consumed only by the next, so a pearl-stage output needs its bead-stage input. Step 3: publish a pulse ledger where each artifact carries its slot, accepting one per bead per slot, so clones spawning in parallel collide and waste turns. Step 4: route stages through separate operator pools, so a beacon needs countersignature from a party that never saw the owner. One agent pays one cost; many replicas pay repeatedly for one ceiling.
